explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/732: are there necessary and sufficient conditions for a sequence 1 < X_1 ≤ … ≤ X_m ≤ n to be block-compatible (the block sizes of a pairwise balanced design on [n])? blockSizeProfiles n is the set of sorted block-size lists of PBDs on Fin n (blocks of size ≥ 2, each pair in exactly one block). The statement asks for an answer predicate characterising membership; adequacy is up to human judgement. Faithful.
